meta.name: BLIF Circuit
meta.description: A gate-level netlist in BLIF format (for example from yosys write_blif); its pins come from .inputs and .outputs

blif.label: BLIF
blif.title: The netlist text. Supported: .model, .inputs, .outputs, .names covers, .latch, .conn, .subckt/.gate of yosys gate cells or of other models in the text

summary.label: Netlist
summary.title: What the text describes, or why it cannot be used

netlistErrors.mixedCover: a cover mixes rows for output 1 and output 0
netlistErrors.tooLarge: the netlist has more than {{max}} cells
netlistErrors.latchNoClock: .latch without a clock is not supported

evo.broken: its text has an error ({{message}}); written as is, Logisim-evolution will not load it either
evo.continuation: line {{line}} continues with "\", which Logisim-evolution does not join
evo.cover: line {{line}} has a .names truth table; Logisim-evolution only reads the constants $true / $false / $undef (map to its gate cells and use yosys write_blif -icells -conn)
evo.cell: line {{line}} uses cell {{cell}}, which Logisim-evolution does not know (it has BUF, NOT, AND, OR, XOR, NAND, NOR, NXOR, ANDNOT, ORNOT, MUX, DFF, DFFSR, DLATCH, PULLUP, PULLDOWN, BUS, TRIS, TRISI)
evo.latch: line {{line}} has a .latch, which Logisim-evolution skips without a word
evo.models: the text has more than one .model; Logisim-evolution needs a flat netlist (yosys synth -flatten)
evo.importBroken: the BLIF text cannot be used here ({{message}}); it is kept so it can be fixed
